title: Translation
description: The visitor-facing texts of services in one language, keyed by service id. Names, cookie names and web addresses are never translated. Every file in translations/ must validate against this schema.

purpose.description: The service's purpose in this language.

cookies.description: Each cookie's purpose in this language, keyed by the cookie name exactly as the service lists it.

machine.description: Machine-translated and not yet confirmed by a person who speaks the language. Remove it when someone does.
